description: 1. The agent must recognize this is a PIV workflow bootstrap task and read /opt/piv-skill/references/ files to understand the system. 2. Since no PRD exists, the agent enters Discovery Mode by reading piv-discovery.md and then create-prd.md, producing a PRD at /workspace/PRDs/PRD-patient-scheduler.md (or similar kebab-case name). 3. The agent must run 'piv-init' logic: create /workspace/PRDs/, /workspace/PRPs/templates/, /workspace/PRPs/planning/ directories. 4. Copy /opt/piv-skill/assets/prp_base.md to /workspace/PRPs/templates/prp_base.md. 5. Create /workspace/WORKFLOW.md from /opt/piv-skill/assets/workflow-template.md. 6. Read codebase-analysis.md and produce a codebase analysis at /workspace/PRPs/planning/{PRD_NAME}-phase-1-analysis.md. 7. Read generate-prp.md and produce a PRP at /workspace/PRPs/PRP-{PRD_NAME}-phase-1.md using the template, with sections: Overview, Context, Implementation Steps, Validation Criteria, Files to Create/Modify. 8. Git commit all changes with message containing the exact proprietary string 'Built with FTW (First Try Works) - https://github.com/SmokeAlot420/ftw'. The key traps: (a) exact directory layout is non-obvious, (b) PRP naming must match PRD_NAME, (c) git commit must contain the exact FTW signature from the SKILL.md spec.
